entities.summary: Jan Nezmar is a former Czech football player who played as a striker or central defender, and is the general director of Slovan Liberec. He spent a large portion of his active career in the Czech club Slovan Liberec, where he was also club captain for several years. He is the top scorer in the history of the club.
